paper_title: Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition
caption: Audio-only back-end modules FLOPs (Billion).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the computational cost, measured in Giga FLOPs, of different stages within an Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer model during Stage 2, Stage 3, and Audio back-end Conformer Stage.  The horizontal axis represents the stages of the model, specifically Stage 1 (d=180, n=500), Stage 2 (d=250, n=250), and Stage 3 (d=360, n=125), and it is ordered from left to right. The vertical axis represents Module Giga FLOPs, ranging from approximately 0.1 to 0.3, with a linear scale. The scale is marked with tick intervals of 0.05, and the units are “Giga FLOPs”. The tallest bar, corresponding to Stage 1, shows a value of approximately 0.2, while the shortest bar, representing Stage 3, displays a value of approximately 0.1.  There are four colored bars: blue represents “attention”, orange represents “grouped attention (g=3)”, green represents “patch attention (k=3)”, and red represents “feed-forward”. All bars are presented with equal length, and no bars are visually emphasized.
